history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain a dense feedforward network with exact columns: THREE cyan input circular nodes, FOUR green first-hidden nodes, THREE green second-hidden nodes, TWO red raw-score nodes, then a distinct compact neutral output-transform region and two blue final output nodes. Every input connects once to all four first-hidden nodes; every first-hidden connects once to all three second-hidden; every second-hidden connects once to both raw scores. No recurrent, skip or cross-layer edges. Hidden layers include nonlinear activations as small adjacent operator motifs, score-to-task transform kept distinct. Do not inflate circle counts. Bias omitted intentionally. Use a spacious horizontal scientific network with fine light links and clearly separated level headings; visual emphasis goes to representation transformation, not giant cards. Leave one blank heading row above and one annotation row below each column. Show hidden features as tiny flat texture/grid motifs below the network if useful, not extra neurons.

Revise THIS newly generated draft only. Preserve composition and exact 3/4/3/2 neuron counts and two outputs. Scientific fix: the FOUR first-layer activation squares MUST each connect once to EACH of the THREE second hidden circles: exactly twelve edges in this middle dense bipartite set. The THREE second-layer activation squares MUST each connect once to BOTH red raw-score circles: exactly six edges. Currently outer sources omit distant destinations. Add missing edges and keep thin light graphite routing, endpoint arrowheads. Don't add neurons or weights. All actual trainable connectivity is fully dense between adjacent levels. Keep white background and NO text/digits/formulas/watermark. Make fills paler, smooth flat solid, no texture or 3D.
